body_markdown:
**LAS VEGAS – For the thousands of individuals[attending MJBizCon](https://mjbizconference.com/?utm_source=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=content&utm_term=mjbdeditarticle&__hstc=150985961.0714fcef0c84766166221d8f4fc5ba77.1750198333003.1750198333003.1750207475354.2&__hssc=150985961.1.1750207475354&__hsfp=3186337733) this week, their goals and objectives for the conference and exhibition are as diverse as the show itself – often considered the Super Bowl of cannabis business events.**


**For some attendees – such as Susie Plascencia, a speaker at Tuesday’s Marketing Forum – the nearly weeklong conference and trade show will provide ample opportunities to produce new content and connections.**
